prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final game RGBA sprite animation sheet. Reference image is character identity ONLY. Create ONE abel walking cycle with exactly EIGHT deliberately DIFFERENT gait poses arranged 4 columns × 2 rows, in chronological order left to right, then next row. Abel: mature adult professor, brown/tan skin, curly red hair, thin golden glasses, bright red academic mantle with fine gold lines, black tunic and loose black trousers, two black boots, golden staff with red faceted crystal and crescent finials held in his right hand. Identity, clothing, face and accessories faithfully match the reference. Do NOT add fire aura to a normal walking sprite. Direction: FRONT view, facing DOWN toward the viewer. Arms counter-swing against moving legs; cloak hem/sash moves with gait, staff moves subtly but identity stays consistent. Premium Japanese anime fantasy game style, clean ink, cel shading, detailed enough to match Mushoku Tensei/Fate aesthetic, proportional mature adult, not child/chibi. Every cell shows ENTIRE body head to BOTH feet and staff, same body scale, centered on own cell with generous transparent gutter at least10% on all sides. No symbols, labels, numbers, text, ground, background, cast shadow, gradient matte, additional characters, or surrounding aura. Actual transparent alpha outside silhouette. Exactly2 arms2 hands2 legs, correct joints and hands. Wide sheet4x2, cells visually isolated. Prioritize observable differences between heel contact, passing foot, knee lift, and opposite-leg contact over tiny decorative variations.
